title: TrialWatch Legal Tripwire: India — provisional law review indices

summary.note: Counts from the cached metadata snapshot, not population denominators.
summary.selection: Lowest SHA-256(CNR) within each parent-law metadata stratum, up to four CNRs; union; latest final order in 2024-25 if available, otherwise latest order.
summary.unit: CNR proceeding; not an independent FIR/case family, journalist, or charge.
summary.law_assignment: Named Act in metadata; never inferred from order year. Operative PDF text can expose conflicts. Only the small reviewed subset is corrected/confirmed.
summary.gold_dataset_status: No independent expert gold labels and no measured generalization performance.
summary.sc_selection: Purposive doctrinal benchmarks from inspected-year metadata; not a random Supreme Court outcome sample.

score_definition: Statute-as-written plus linked central procedural classification. Six analyst-proposed 0-2 ratings; equal-weight sum/12*100, rounded. Higher means more review flags under THIS rubric.
validation_status: Provisional AI-assisted analyst coding; not independently legally validated; not an abuse probability or learned risk model.

weight_sensitivity.distribution: Independent Uniform(0.5,1.5) criterion weights, normalized in the score formula.
weight_sensitivity.interpretation: 5th-95th percentile assumption band, not a statistical confidence interval. Rank envelopes include ties and are within era only.

criteria.label: Reach into expression
anchors: No express publication, words, or communication limb.
Communication limb confined to a defined class of protected official information.
Words, publication, or expressive content are an express route to liability.

criteria.label: Evaluative trigger language
anchors: Concrete conduct and object; no evaluative expression or harm trigger identified.
Evaluative trigger bounded by a specified object, such as reputation, religious insult, or obstruction of official functions.
Open political, group-affective, morality, or national-security terms, including potential harm rather than a specified completed injury.

criteria.label: Explicit mental-state gap
anchors: A specific deliberate/malicious harmful purpose is expressly required in the selected limb.
Knowledge, reason to believe, voluntariness, a purpose presumption, or mixed intent/effect routes; no specific malicious purpose required throughout.
No express mental-state qualifier in the selected expression limb. This is a TEXT feature, not a claim of strict liability.

criteria.label: Express expression-safeguard gap
anchors: Several express criticism/reporting exceptions or a broad public-good/art/learning exception in the linked text.
A conditional lawful-criticism or reasonable-belief/good-faith exception.
No general criticism, reporting, or public-interest exception identified in the selected provision/linked definition.

criteria.label: Arrest/bail exposure
anchors: Non-cognizable AND bailable under the linked central schedule.
Cognizable OR non-bailable, but not both.
Cognizable AND non-bailable, or a specific statutory anticipatory-bail bar.

criteria.label: Maximum imprisonment
anchors: Maximum up to and including two years.
Maximum greater than two and up to seven years.
Maximum greater than seven years, life imprisonment, or death.

it.access: Web tool PDF text verified; local download unavailable

laws.name: IPC 124A — sedition (historical; 2022 abeyance order)
laws.notes: Historical text only. The 11 May 2022 Supreme Court order kept 124A proceedings in abeyance and restrained fresh use; this is not an active offence recommendation. BNS 152 is a related provision with different wording, not a one-to-one renumbering.
laws.coding_status: AI-assisted analyst proposal; no independent legal coding or outcome validation

speech_reach.reason: Words, signs and representations are expressly covered.

open_texture.reason: Hatred, contempt and disaffection against the government are broad affective/political triggers.

mental_state_gap.reason: No express mental-state qualifier in the operative textual trigger; Kedar Nath judicial limitations are separate.

safeguard_gap.reason: Explanations protect disapprobation seeking lawful alteration without the specified prohibited effects.

custody.reason: CrPC central schedule: cognizable and non-bailable.

historical_panel.note: Metadata counts are retrieval denominators. Subsection rows share the parent denominator. Zero reviewed confirmations is not an absence finding.
